name: Blueprint-Bench
intro: Blueprint-Bench 通过把约 20 张公寓室内照片重建为二维平面图，评估通用模型的空间智能。数据包含 50 套公寓；模型输出须遵循九项四色规则，评估器直接抽取房间连通图、大小排序、门数量与方向并计算加权相似度，不会替模型规范化不合规提交。
build_method: 公寓房源照片与官方平面图, 九项四色格式规范, 确定性计算机视觉结构抽取
metric: Weighted Floor-Plan Similarity (Edge Jaccard, Degree Correlation, Density, Room/Door Counts, Door Orientation)
task_type: 多图空间重建, 平面图生成, Agent绘图
eval_feature: 模型无关输出, 确定性图结构评分, LLM/图像模型/Agent同台比较, 人类与随机基线
scale: 50套公寓, 每套约20张室内照片; 人类基线使用12套子集
task_type_en: Multi-image spatial reconstruction, floor-plan generation, agent drawing
build_method_en: Apartment-listing photos and official floor plans, nine-rule four-color format, deterministic computer-vision structure extraction
eval_feature_en: Model-agnostic output, deterministic graph scoring, shared LLM/image-model/agent comparison, human and random baselines
intro_en: Blueprint-Bench evaluates general-model spatial intelligence by reconstructing a 2D floor plan from about 20 interior apartment photographs. It contains 50 apartments; model outputs must follow nine four-color rules, after which the evaluator directly extracts room connectivity, size ranking, and door counts and orientations for weighted scoring. It does not normalize a noncompliant submission for the model.
scale_en: 50 apartments, about 20 interior photos each; human baseline on a 12-apartment subset
metric_en: Weighted Floor-Plan Similarity (Edge Jaccard, Degree Correlation, Density, Room/Door Counts, Door Orientation)

drawio_review_note: REDRAW review aligned with arXiv:2509.25229v1 Sections 2.1-2.4 and official generation repository snapshot 6e9b9a62eeb5dc0a43718045a2b1e79b41725eaa. The corrected diagram preserves 50 apartments with about 20 photos each, the nine black/green/red/white rules, image-model, SVG-LLM, and Linux-agent paths, direct red-center/flood-fill/green-door extraction, structured size-ranked room graphs, the six 50/20/10/10/5/5 weighted components, human and no-image baselines, and the public comparison. It does not invent normalization or enforcement of a submitted image: noncompliant output may be unscorable or may not be scored as intended.
